items.title: Sentry Base Theme
items.description: Complete Sentry design system theme for shadcn — purple-tinted neutrals, Blurple primary, Rubik typography, both light and dark modes. Includes warning, success, and promotion semantic tokens beyond the shadcn defaults.

items.description: Sentry alert with the colored icon rail, system banner, expand/collapse, trailing items, and AlertLink.

items.description: Contextual highlighted text element with semantic and feature variants.
